topic.title: Printer Notices
topic.shortdesc: This library groups notices that can be used for content reference (conref). Each element that you want to conref to should be in a separate note <element>.

p.note: Do not remove or touch the copper contacts on the ink cartridge. Touching these parts may adversely affect the performance of the printer.
If you slam the document cover, the document may move out of alignment and you may damage the printer.
Do not place heavy objects on the glass.
Cancel print jobs and turn off the printer before attempting to remove jammed paper.
Be careful not to cut your fingers on the sharp paper edges.
Do not print with the document cover open. The bright light is dangerous to your eyes.
To have improved performance, plug the USB cable directly into the computer. Do not plug it into a USB hub.
